title: Harbor Light Diorama
details: 📅 Q3 · Unit 7 · Regions of the United States

badge.name: Harbor Light Ribbon
badge.line: Only VR curators earn this one. You scouted a lighthouse and told why the Northeast coast needs it.

hook.look: A work order is a note that tells museum workers what job to do next.
hook.head: Work Order 19 · Harbor Light Diorama
hook.alt: The Statue of Liberty on a small island with tall city buildings across the water
hook.cap: New York Harbor today. Northeast cities grew up by harbors.
hook.note: Our Northeast alcove needs a lighthouse. Please visit one at night and tell me about it!

opti.brief: Curators, the Northeast has a rocky coast and busy harbors. Visit a lighthouse at night, then record a short video for me.
opti.collections: No headset today? Come to the collections room. Play the game, then tell me what you found.

voice.brief: Curators, the Northeast has a rocky coast and busy harbors. Visit a lighthouse at night, then record a short video for me.
voice.step1: Before your headset, read about the place. Then press Practice and say your two sentences before the timer ends.
voice.step2: Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type the map word, click the map, then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Move with the thumbstick. Look up at the light, then out at the water. Stand where you can see both.
voice.step4: Open Library, then Camera. Click Record video and say your two sentences. Click again to stop. Then send it on the Canvas tab.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open the Canvas assignment and check that your video is there.
voice.extra: Have more time? Start your video on the water, then turn slowly up to the light.
voice.collections: No headset today? Come to the collections room. Play the game, then tell me what you found.

vr.look: A lighthouse is a tall tower with a bright light. A harbor is deep, calm water where ships stop safely. The Northeast coast on the Atlantic is rocky.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Lighthouse in Filter environments. Click Lighthouse (Night), then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the lighthouse
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Look up at the light. Look out at the water. Find one spot where you can see the lighthouse and the sea.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the lighthouse fits.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Point the camera at the water first, then slowly up to the light, so Opti sees what the ships see.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the lighthouse while you say both sentences.

place.alt: An old photo of tall city buildings seen from the water
place.html: Why it matters: at night, a lighthouse shows ships where the rocks are.
place.cap: New York City seen from its harbor, about 1912.

say: This is a lighthouse, and I see ___.

studio.title: Land or Water?
studio.look: Six museum cards. Each one shows a Northeast resource. A resource is something from nature that people use. Two boxes wait below: one for the land, one for the water.
studio.do: Tap a card in the tray. Then tap the box it goes in. You can also drag the card.

labels.step: Tap a card, then tap its box.

game.miss: Not that box. Does this come from the land or from the water?
game.done: The tray is empty! The Northeast uses its land and its ocean.

cards.name: Lobster
cards.what: Caught off the coast of Maine
cards.ok: Yes! Lobster comes from the ocean off Maine.

cards.name: Maple syrup
cards.what: Made from maple tree sap in spring
cards.ok: Yes! Maple syrup comes from trees on the land.

cards.name: Coal
cards.what: Dug out of the ground in Pennsylvania
cards.ok: Yes! Coal is dug from the land. It powered factories and trains.

cards.name: Fish
cards.ok: Yes! Fishing villages grew up along the Northeast coast.

cards.name: Apples
cards.ok: Yes! Apples grow in orchards on the land.

cards.name: A safe harbor
cards.ok: Yes! Harbors made the Northeast a place for trade.

studio.full: All six cards are in a box, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
